1	import { pgTable, uuid, text, timestamp, jsonb, uniqueIndex } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
2	import { plugins } from "./plugins.js";
3	
4	/**
5	 * `plugin_config` table — stores operator-provided instance configuration
6	 * for each plugin (one row per plugin, enforced by a unique index on
7	 * `plugin_id`).
8	 *
9	 * The `config_json` column holds the values that the operator enters in the
10	 * plugin settings UI. These values are validated at runtime against the
11	 * plugin's `instanceConfigSchema` from the manifest.
12	 *
13	 * @see PLUGIN_SPEC.md §21.3
14	 */
15	export const pluginConfig = pgTable(
16	  "plugin_config",
17	  {
18	    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
19	    pluginId: uuid("plugin_id")
20	      .notNull()
21	      .references(() => plugins.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
22	    configJson: jsonb("config_json").$type<Record<string, unknown>>().notNull().default({}),
23	    lastError: text("last_error"),
24	    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
25	    updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
26	  },
27	  (table) => ({
28	    pluginIdIdx: uniqueIndex("plugin_config_plugin_id_idx").on(table.pluginId),
29	  }),
30	);
31
